title: Adversarial prior-art search protocol
tests_passed: RED: public protocol symbols were absent
RED: mutation budget zero blocked the initial search and no can_mutate API existed
GREEN: 2 protocol tests passed after separating search rounds from mutations
Protocol plus P01 contract regression: 9 passed
mypy: success, no issues found in 2 source files
decisions: P10-T01 reuses P01 PriorArtQuery/PriorArtMatch/PriorArtAssessment rather than duplicating result contracts.
Protocol stages are immutable and ordered: lattice, five search variants, five scouts, skeptic, verdict.
Search-round and mutation budgets are independent so max_mutations=0 permits the first evidence search but forbids mutations.
Allowed verdicts are derived from PriorArtVerdict and cannot include PROVEN_NEW.
risks: No query lattice, scout adapter, external query, similarity comparison, skeptic, verdict engine, or mutation loop exists yet; they belong to P10-T02 through P10-T10.
The protocol constrains caller scheduling but does not persist executions; persistence/integration is later phase work.
cost: COST=0; no network calls or billable services used.
rollback: git revert <P10-T01 commit> after commit, or git restore --source=HEAD -- src/criba/intelligence/prior_art/__init__.py && git clean -f -- src/criba/intelligence/prior_art/protocol.py tests/intelligence/test_prior_art_protocol.py .hermes/iie/tasks/P10-T01.json before commit.
follow_up: P10-T02: implement a deterministic query lattice.
